title: Account Info
content:
Info Component
The Info component provides a snapshot of the account's balance, status, and trading parameters. Traders can choose between their active accounts from the account drop-down to review the account's balance, RP&L, UP&L, and trading parameters.
Traders can also enable the Manual Lockout feature from the info component by clicking "Lockout". Please refer to the Trading Lock-Out page for more information.
Please note that once a Lock-Out is enabled on an account, it cannot be reversed. This feature is designed to help you step away from trading when you're ready to call it a day.
